limitations: LoD2 is generalized, not a facade survey. Peterskirche roof tip at approximately 47 m is a reconstruction; the parish gives 48 m including the weathercock. No weathercock, facade ornaments, physical print or worldwide exact-building guarantee. See LANDMARK-SOURCES.md.
